actions.do_not_use_when: Do not use when the exact request or response schema for one known action is needed.
actions.name: actions
actions.use_when: Discover every canonical xcov.v1 action and its selection boundary.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not use to execute a coverage query.
actions.name: schema
actions.use_when: Read the strict request or response contract for one canonical action.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not use an existing session_id; close it explicitly before opening another VDB under that name.
actions.name: session.open
actions.use_when: Open exactly one requested VDB in a new named coverage session.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not use to query coverage scores or holes.
actions.name: session.status
actions.use_when: Inspect one live coverage session without scanning coverage objects.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not use before all queries against that session are complete.
actions.name: session.close
actions.use_when: Close one live coverage session and release its backend.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not use for hierarchy scopes or coverage metrics.
actions.name: tests.list
actions.use_when: List coverage tests present in the opened VDB.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not use when hierarchy holes or individual source evidence are required.
actions.name: metrics.list
actions.use_when: Summarize merged coverage metrics for a scope from the URG summary index.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not use to enumerate child scopes or detailed uncovered objects.
actions.name: scope.summary
actions.use_when: Get the aggregate coverage score for one scope or top-level scopes.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not use for a name-pattern search across the selected subtree.
actions.name: scope.children
actions.use_when: Enumerate direct or recursive descendants of one hierarchy scope.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not use when only direct children of a known scope are needed.
actions.name: scope.search
actions.use_when: Find hierarchy scopes using query glob filters.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not use for hierarchy-level holes or detailed Markdown evidence.
actions.name: code_coverage.summary
actions.use_when: Aggregate code-coverage scores by a declared grouping field.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not use when only uncovered functional items are required.
actions.name: functional_coverage.summary
actions.use_when: Aggregate functional coverage at covergroup, coverpoint, cross, or bin level.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not use for the detailed assertion Markdown report.
actions.name: assert.summary
actions.use_when: Summarize assertion attempts, successes, and basic coverage.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not use for inline hierarchy summaries.
actions.name: export.code_coverage
actions.use_when: Write strict per-instance code-coverage JSON, XOUT, and raw URG artifacts.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not use for inline functional coverage rows.
actions.name: export.functional_coverage
actions.use_when: Write detailed functional-coverage holes to a Markdown artifact.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not use for the compact assertion summary.
actions.name: export.assert
actions.use_when: Write detailed assertion coverage evidence to a Markdown artifact.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not concatenate or parse native EL text.
actions.name: exclude.load
actions.use_when: Load one or more native EL files in order using pynpi union semantics.

actions.do_not_use_when: Use export gap IDs for portable exclusions; coverage_ref is session-local.
actions.name: exclude.add
actions.use_when: Set report-time exclusion state for exact coverage references.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not use to remove immutable compile-time exclusions.
actions.name: exclude.remove
actions.use_when: Clear report-time exclusion state for exact coverage references.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not use module definitions, wildcards, regex, or synthetic hierarchy scopes.
actions.name: exclude.instance.add
actions.use_when: Atomically exclude exact or URG-XML-expanded instance targets.

actions.do_not_use_when: Recursive removal uses recorded exact ownership and never re-expands current XML.
actions.name: exclude.instance.remove
actions.use_when: Atomically remove owned exact instance exclusions.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not use this action for functional bins.
actions.name: exclude.functional.add
actions.use_when: Atomically exclude exact covergroup, coverpoint, or cross containers.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not use this action for functional bins.
actions.name: exclude.functional.remove
actions.use_when: Atomically remove owned covergroup, coverpoint, or cross exclusions.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not request append or strict-save modes.
actions.name: export.exclude
actions.use_when: Export current merged-test exclusions with save_exclude_file(path, "w").

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not use as an implementation of single-object removal.
actions.name: exclude.unload_all
actions.use_when: Clear all report-time exclusions after explicit confirmation.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not use to apply or compile exclusions.
actions.name: exclude.csv.validate
actions.use_when: 逐行校验 CSV 格式、selector 语句格式、VDB object 存在性。最多返回前 10 条错误。

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not publish native EL artifacts.
actions.name: exclude.csv.apply
actions.use_when: Resolve and apply all exactly matched CSV exclusions to the current session.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not publish partial output when any selector fails.
actions.name: exclude.csv.compile
actions.use_when: Validate, resolve, apply, and atomically publish three native EL files.

actions.do_not_use_when: Do not change exclusion semantics.
actions.name: exclude.csv.format
actions.use_when: Check stable grouped CSV ordering, or write it only with write=true.

actions.do_not_use_when: Does not persist exclusions that originated only from native EL files.
actions.name: exclude.csv.export
actions.use_when: Atomically merge reason-bearing session exclusions into portable CSV files.
